note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled 31 May 1911: six contests. "The Newry No. 2 Rural District Council now consists of the following 24 elected members (two for each division)" (Newry Reporter, 3 June 1911, p. 7). No party labels are printed. Polled 31 May 1911; declared on Thursday 1 June at the Newry Workhouse by W. R. Bell, deputy returning officer. Two seats; the figures are the candidate totals. Both sitting members were re-elected. 232 votes recorded (including 8 spoilt) of 288 on the register.
